entities.summary: Nagore Gabellanes Marieta is a former field hockey player from Spain. She was a member of the Women's National Team that surprisingly won the golden medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics on home soil (Barcelona). She also competed in the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia, where Spain finished in 8th and last position. Nagore Gabellanes was a athletes & competitors from San Sebastián (b. 1973-01-25, San Sebastián). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
